processes.why: The loop that converts an AI feature from a demo into something with acceptance criteria. Everything else in this system feeds it.
processes.metric: Hits at stated k, precision, and the count of blocking-case failures

s: Refresh ground truth from recent real traffic
Sample 5–10 real queries and fold them in; retire questions that no longer resemble what arrives.
Commit predictions
Write expected hits and precision before running. This is the calibration entry.
Confirm the configuration under test
Model version, k, prompt version, retrieval method. A number without its configuration is not a result.
Run programmatic checks
Citation present, cited chunk retrieved, quote verbatim in source. These run free on every commit.
Run the judge on the full set
Single dimension, rubric-based, offending quote required.
Spot-check judge agreement
Hand-label a sample; if agreement has drifted, the judge needs rework before its numbers are used.
Record cost and latency
Cost per query, p50, p95 alongside quality. Three numbers, one line.
Compare against prediction
Log the gap. Direction matters more than magnitude.
Read every failure
Not the summary — the actual outputs, against their sources.
Update the taxonomy
New cluster, or a count increment on an existing one.
Check the blocking cases
Any failure here stops the release regardless of aggregate scores.
Fix the largest cluster
One change at a time, so the next measurement is attributable.
Add new regression cases
Every fixed bug earns a permanent test.
Update the system card evaluation section
Numbers, k, date.
Record the cycle
What changed, what moved, what did not.

processes.why: Most document-AI projects fail upstream of anything anyone measures. This is the sequence that catches it before indexing, when it is still cheap.
processes.metric: Percentage of corpus that is clean text; percentage of answers needing tables; metadata completeness

s: Sample 30 documents and classify
Clean digital text, scanned image, or mixed.
Sample 20 real questions
How many need a table or figure to answer? This number is usually the highest and almost never asked.
Test extraction on the worst pages
Multi-column, tabular, scanned. Read the output as a machine would.
Decide text-first, vision-first or hybrid
From the measured evidence, not from preference.
Define required metadata
Version, effective date, status, owning scope, document type.
Establish the right to use
Where it came from, under what permission, retained how long, stored where.
Identify superseded content
Anything repealed, expired or draft. No retrieval technique detects this.
Plan the deletion path
Before ingestion, know how one document comes back out of all seven stores.
Choose the cutting rule from the anatomy
Clauses, procedures, sections — whatever the document type actually uses.
Generate situating sentences for orphan-prone chunks
One cheap call per chunk at index time; nothing at query time.
Embed with the correct input_type
Passages as passage. Getting this wrong degrades silently.
Verify with spot retrieval
Ten known questions before declaring the index built.

processes.why: Converts a sales meeting into an evaluation. The measurement happens on your ground truth or it has not happened.
processes.metric: Claims converted to evidence; measured delta on your own question set

s: Write down what you would need to see to say yes
Do this first, or the demo sets the criteria for you.
Pull the matching questions from the Vendor Deck
One per claim you expect to hear.
Prepare your ground truth for handover
The measurement must be on your questions.
Ask which claims are retrieval and which are training
"Trained on your documents" is almost always retrieval.
Ask for the configuration behind every number
k, model calls per request, retries, reasoning, cached or not.
Ask what survives a successful prompt injection
Separates filters from controls immediately.
Ask the deprecation notice period
Routinely omitted, and it is an operational emergency scheduled in advance.
Run their system against your ground truth
Including your unanswerable questions.
Model the loaded cost at your real volume
Their per-query price is a floor, not an estimate.
Write the recommendation with a limits section
Title it Findings, not Recommendations, and say what you did not test.

processes.why: An AI feature fails differently from ordinary software: it fails plausibly, at scale, and without an exception in a log.
processes.metric: Time to containment; whether the trace was sufficient to reproduce

s: Pull the kill switch if user-facing harm is possible
Route to the non-AI path. This is not a rollback and does not wait for a deploy.
Preserve traces
Query, retrieval, prompt version, model version, output. Without these you cannot reconstruct anything.
Determine blast radius
How many outputs, over what window, reaching whom.
Classify the failure
Retrieval (wrong evidence), generation (right evidence, wrong answer), extraction (wrong page reading), or injection.
Reproduce it
If you cannot reproduce it from the trace, your instrumentation is the first fix.
Check whether existing eval cases should have caught it
If not, that gap is the real finding.
Fix and verify against a new regression case
The case comes first; it must fail before the fix and pass after.
Add the failure to the taxonomy
With its count and severity.
Update the system card known-limitations section
Honestly.
Write the note for whoever owns the risk register
Including whether the defence that failed was a filter or a control.

processes.why: Your provider will retire the model you validated against, on their schedule. Teams that own their artifacts do this in an afternoon; teams that do not discover they never knew whether the old model was any good either.
processes.metric: Elapsed time; number of metrics that moved outside tolerance

s: Re-run ground truth on the CURRENT model
You need today's number, not the one from six months ago.
Record cost and latency on the current model
p50 and p95.
Confirm the regression suite passes on current
If it does not, fix that before migrating anything.
Run the same ground truth
Same k, same prompts, same corpus.
Run the regression suite and the blocking cases
No exceptions for "close enough".
Re-test injection resistance
Defences are model-dependent; capture rate changes with the model.
Re-measure judge agreement
If the judge model changed too, it is a new instrument.
Measure cost and latency
New model, new economics. Sometimes better.
Compare within stated tolerance
Decide in advance what counts as acceptable drift.
Update prompts only if measurably required
Prompt drift during migration makes attribution impossible.
Stage the rollout
Canary, watch online metrics, keep the kill switch armed.
Update the system card and pin the new version
With the migration date and the numbers.

hinglish.A prediction machine trained on large qu: Ek prediction machine, jo bahut saare text par train hui hai. Yeh text ko aage plausibly badhaati hai — kuchh look up nahi karti.
hinglish.Sending the envelope (a JSON request) to: Envelope (ek JSON request) model ko bhejna aur uska reply lena.
hinglish.A word-piece — the unit the model reads,: Ek word-piece — yahi unit model padhta hai, likhta hai, aur isi par bill banta hai. Lagbhag ek English word ka ¾.
hinglish.The maximum size of one envelope: everyt: Ek envelope ka maximum size: andar jaane wala sab kuchh, plus bahar aane wala sab kuchh.
hinglish.Total amnesia — nothing survives between: Poori amnesia — model ki taraf do requests ke beech kuchh bhi nahi bachta.
hinglish.The receipt: prompt tokens read in, comp: Receipt: kitne prompt tokens andar padhe gaye, kitne completion tokens bahar likhe gaye.
hinglish.The standing briefing page placed in eve: Woh standing briefing page jo har envelope mein user ke message se pehle rakha jaata hai.
hinglish.The variety dial, 0 to ~1. Zero = consis: Variety ka dial, 0 se ~1 tak. Zero = consistent; high = creative.
hinglish.Confident generation of plausible-but-fa: Plausible dikhne wala lekin galat content, poore confidence ke saath. Knowledge ke kinare par yeh normal behaviour hai, glitch nahi.
hinglish.Any mechanism reducing harmful or wrong: Koi bhi tareeka jo harmful ya galat output kam kare. Sabse simple guardrail system prompt ka ek sentence hai.
hinglish.One piece of a cut-up document — the uni: Kaate gaye document ka ek tukda — yahi unit store aur retrieve hota hai.
hinglish.The cutting itself — a design decision w: Kaatna khud — ek design decision jo dikhta chhote se kaam jaisa hai.
hinglish.Cutting every N words regardless of mean: Har N words par kaat dena, matlab dekhe bina.
hinglish.Cutting along the document's own structu: Document ke apne structure ke hisaab se kaatna.
hinglish.Repeating the last lines of one chunk at: Ek chunk ki aakhri lines agle chunk ki shuruaat mein dohraana, taaki boundary par baithe jawaab na tootein.
hinglish.Fetching, from all stored chunks, the fe: Saare stored chunks mein se woh chand nikaalna jo sawaal ka jawaab de sakte hain.
hinglish.Retrieval by shared words — matches spel: Common words ke aadhaar par retrieval — spelling match karta hai, matlab nahi samajhta.
hinglish.Keyword and semantic search run together: Keyword aur semantic search dono saath chalaana, phir results ko merge karna.
hinglish.Take the best k results — the dial betwe: Top k results lena — recall aur precision ke beech ka dial.
hinglish.A text's address on the meaning map — a: Meaning map par ek text ka pata — lagbhag 1024 numbers ki list.
hinglish.The mapmaker — reads text, outputs its a: Naksha banane wala — text padhta hai, uska pata deta hai.
hinglish.The one-line neighbour test — higher = c: Ek line ka neighbour test — jitna zyada, utna matlab mein paas.
hinglish.Retrieval by meaning-map addresses inste: Spelling ki jagah meaning-map ke pate se retrieval.
hinglish.The declaration of whether you are embed: Yeh batana ki aap sawaal embed kar rahe hain ya document ka tukda. Ise chhod dijiye to quality chupchaap girti hai.
hinglish.A system that stores embeddings and find: Aisa system jo embeddings store karta hai aur nearest neighbours tezi se dhoondhta hai.
hinglish.Grading the system against verified expe: System ko verified expectations ke against jaanchna — AI ke liye acceptance testing.
hinglish.The pre-verified answer key: questions,: Pehle se verify kiya hua answer key: sawaal, sahi jawaab, aur woh kahan likhe hain.
hinglish.Of what mattered, how much was fetched?: Jo zaroori tha usme se kitna aaya? Kam matlab files chhoot rahi hain.
hinglish.Of what was fetched, how much mattered?: Jo aaya usme se kitna kaam ka tha? Kam matlab mez par kachra bhara hai.
hinglish.Pre-agreed numbers and behaviours requir: Go-live se pehle tay kiye gaye numbers aur behaviour.
hinglish.Retrieval-Augmented Generation — retriev: Retrieval-Augmented Generation — pehle verified text nikaalo, phir usi se jawaab banao.
hinglish.A formal description of required output: Output ka shape formally likhna: kaunse fields, kis type ke, kya zaroori hai.
hinglish.Model output constrained to a schema rat: Model ka output free prose ki jagah ek schema mein bandha hua.
hinglish.Only schema-valid tokens permitted at ea: Har step par sirf woh tokens allowed jo schema ke hisaab se sahi hain. Isse invalid output impossible ho jaata hai, sirf kam-likely nahi.
hinglish.A field restricted to a fixed list of al: Aisa field jisme sirf ek fixed list ke values chal sakte hain.
hinglish.A legal, structured way to report \"cann: "Pata nahi" bolne ka ek proper, structured tareeka — warna model ko banane par majboor karna padta hai.
hinglish.Parse → validate → on failure re-ask wit: Parse karo → validate karo → fail ho to error ke saath dobara poochho.
hinglish.Describing callable functions so the mod: Model ko batana ki kaunse functions call ho sakte hain, taaki woh prose mein jawaab dene ki jagah function maang sake.
hinglish.model → tool request → your code execute: model → tool ki request → aapka code chalta hai → result wapas → phir se.
hinglish.The hard maximum number of loop iteratio: Loop kitni baar ghoom sakta hai, iski hard limit. Optional nahi hai.
hinglish.The recorded sequence of steps, calls, a: Ek run ke saare steps, calls, arguments aur results ka record.
hinglish.The line between tools that read and too: Padhne wale tools aur duniya badalne wale tools ke beech ki line.
hinglish.What enters the envelope, in what order,: Envelope mein kya jaata hai, kis order mein, aur kya nikaala jaata hai — wording se alag baat.
hinglish.Degradation in the use of context as it: Context bada hone par uska istemaal kharaab hone lagta hai, ceiling se kaafi pehle.
hinglish.Material at the start and end is recover: Shuruaat aur ant ka material beech ke material se kahin zyada bharose se yaad rehta hai.
hinglish.Provider-side reuse of a processed reque: Provider ki taraf se request ke shuru ka hissa dobara istemaal karna. Sthir cheezein pehle, badalne wali baad mein.
hinglish.Summarising older context to free budget: Purana context summarise karke jagah banana, lekin haal ka hissa jaisa ka taisa rakhna.
hinglish.A model that generates an internal worki: Aisa model jo jawaab dene se pehle andar hi andar kaam nikaalta hai.
hinglish.Buying accuracy per query at inference t: Accuracy training ke waqt nahi, har query ke waqt kharid rahe hain.
hinglish.The control setting how much working-out: Yeh control ki kitna soch-vichaar allowed hai. Product decision hai.
hinglish.Median and slow-tail response times. Use: Median aur slow-tail response times. User tail ko mehsoos karta hai.
hinglish.Statistical keyword ranking — Chapter 4': Statistical keyword ranking — Chapter 4 ka scoreboard, theek se banaya hua, jisme rare words ko zyada weight milta hai.
hinglish.Merging ranked lists by summing 1/(rank): Ranked lists ko 1/(rank) jodkar merge karna. Simple, mazboot, haraana mushkil.
hinglish.A model scoring a (question, chunk) pair: Ek model jo (sawaal, chunk) ko saath padhkar score deta hai. Sirf shortlist par lagta hai.
hinglish.Prepending a generated situating sentenc: Har chunk ke aage ek situating sentence lagana, embed karne se pehle. Orphan chunks ka ilaaj.
hinglish.Turning a conversational fragment into a: Baatcheet ke ek tukde ko akela khada rehne wala searchable sawaal banana.
hinglish.Discarding out-of-scope chunks before sc: Score karne se pehle scope ke bahar ke chunks hata dena — version, date, department.
hinglish.Instructions smuggled into a model's inp: Model ke input ke andar chhupa kar bheje gaye instructions, jo uska behaviour mod dete hain.
hinglish.The attack arrives inside content the sy: Attack us content ke andar aata hai jo system padhta hai — document, email, ticket ya page.
hinglish.Private data + untrusted content + exter: Private data + bahar ka untrusted content + bahar bhejne ka rasta. Koi bhi do safe hain.
hinglish.Getting private data out — via email, we: Private data bahar nikalna — email, webhook, URL parameter ya render hui image ke through.
hinglish.A privileged component tricked into misu: Ek privileged component ko bewakoof banakar uski authority kisi unprivileged banda ke liye istemaal karwana.
Allowed destinations ki ek band list. Injection safal ho jaaye tab bhi yeh tikta hai.
hinglish.Using a model to grade outputs against a: Ek model ka istemaal karke outputs ko rubric ke against grade karna.
hinglish.How often the judge concurs with human l: Judge kitni baar insaan ke labels se sehmat hota hai. Yahi number judge ko istemaal layak banata hai.
hinglish.Reading real outputs and open-coding fai: Asli outputs padhkar failures ko apne shabdon mein categories mein baantna. Is field ki sabse zyada faaydemand activity.
hinglish.Your named categories of failure, derive: Aapke apne traffic se nikaali gayi, aapke naam di hui failure categories.
hinglish.Cases that must pass before any release: Woh cases jo har release se pehle pass hone hi chahiye.
hinglish.Against an answer key before release, ve: Release se pehle answer key ke against, aur release ke baad users ke outcomes ke against.
hinglish.The full loaded cost of one user-visible: Ek user-visible request ki poori asli cost, jisme retries aur agent steps bhi shaamil hain.
hinglish.Cheap model first, escalate on a failed: Pehle sasta model, check fail hone par mehnge par bhejo. Production mein sabse aam cost pattern.
hinglish.Choosing a model per request based on th: Har request ke liye uski mushkil ke hisaab se model chunna.
hinglish.Cost and revenue per unit of use — the n: Har use par cost aur revenue — yahi number tay karta hai ki feature zinda rahega ya nahi.
hinglish.A model that reads images and text toget: Aisa model jo images aur text dono saath padhta hai.
hinglish.Treating a rendered page as the retrieva: Text ke tukde ki jagah poore render hue page ko hi retrieval unit maanna.
hinglish.Information present on the page but abse: Jo page par dikhta hai lekin uske extract hue text mein gayab hai.
hinglish.Deciding when a speaker has finished — t: Yeh tay karna ki bolne wala kab ruk gaya — voice interfaces ki sabse badi samasya.
hinglish.Obligation level set by consequence of e: Obligation ka level galti ke nateeje se tay hota hai, technology se nahi.
hinglish.A structured document: purpose, data, ev: Ek structured document: maqsad, data, evaluation, limitations, oversight.
hinglish.Where data came from, under what right,: Data kahan se aaya, kis haq se, kahan rakha hai, kitne samay ke liye.
hinglish.A specified, exercisable review point wi: Ek tay kiya hua review point jo sach mein use ho sake, aur jise overrule karne ka adhikaar ho.
hinglish.Unsanctioned tool use by staff. A measur: Staff ka bina permission ke tools istemaal karna. Yeh naapne layak sachchai hai, koi kalpana nahi.
hinglish.A product specification whose acceptance: Aisa product spec jiske acceptance criteria ek named dataset par eval thresholds hain.
hinglish.Fixing an exact model version so behavio: Model ka exact version fix kar dena, taaki behaviour aapke neeche se na badle.
hinglish.The re-evaluation required when a provid: Provider aapka model band kare to jo poora dobara-naapna karna padta hai.
hinglish.An immediate flag routing traffic to the: Ek turant chalne wala flag jo traffic ko non-AI raste par bhej deta hai. Rollback nahi hai.
hinglish.A program someone uses. The thing with b: Woh program jo koi istemaal karta hai. Buttons wali cheez. App hi model se baat karta hai — model ka apna koi interface, memory ya insaan ka andaaza nahi hota.
hinglish.A way for one program to ask another pro: Ek tareeka jisse ek program doosre program se internet par kaam karwaata hai. Aap ise kabhi dekhte nahi. Jab is course mein likha ho ki aapka app "API call karta hai", matlab aapke app ne model provider ke computers ko message bheja aur jawaab ka intezaar kiya.
hinglish.One such request and its reply. One ques: Ek aisi hi request aur uska reply. Ek sawaal andar, ek jawaab bahar — aur bill par ek charge.
hinglish.A plain-text way of writing structured i: Structured information likhne ka ek plain-text tareeka jise program padh sake: curly braces ke andar labels aur values, jaise {"role": "user", "content": "hello"}. Yeh na code hai na database. Envelope isi format mein likha jaata hai.
hinglish.The specific web address a program sends: Woh exact web address jahan program apni request bhejta hai. Alag endpoints alag kaam karte hain — ek chat ke liye, ek embeddings ke liye.
Request ya reply ke andar jo bhi hai. Envelope ke andar ka saamaan, envelope se alag.
hinglish.A setting you pass with a request — temp: Request ke saath bheji gayi ek setting — temperature, maximum length, kaunsa model. Confusing baat: yahi shabd model ke andar ke arbon numbers ke liye bhi chalta hai. Is course mein iska matlab setting hai, jab tak alag na likha ho.
hinglish.A web page where you can type a few line: Ek web page jahan aap chand lines code likhkar button dabaate hain aur andar kya ho raha hai woh dekhte hain. Yahi tool is course mein istemaal hota hai taaki aapko kuchh install na karna pade. Isme kiya gaya kuchh bhi kuchh tod nahi sakta.
hinglish.The machine actually running your notebo: Woh machine jo aapka notebook code sach mein chala rahi hai. Free notebooks aapko kuchh ghanton ke liye ek deti hain aur phir wapas le leti hain — isiliye kabhi-kabhi key dobara daalni padti hai.
hinglish.To put a change where real users can rea: Badlav ko wahan pahunchana jahan asli users tak pahunch sake. Deploy hone se pehle cheez sirf aapki machine par hoti hai.
hinglish.Putting the previous version back after: Kharaab deploy ke baad pichhla version wapas laana. Yeh aapka code undo karta hai. Model ka behaviour undo nahi karta — isiliye Chapter 18 kehta hai ki kill switch ek alag cheez hai.
hinglish.All the documents your system is allowed: Woh saare documents jinse aapka system jawaab de sakta hai, sab milakar. Aapka source material. Bahuvachan: corpora.
hinglish.A prepared copy of your corpus, arranged: Aapke corpus ki taiyaar ki hui copy, aise arrange ki hui ki dhoondhna tez ho. Ise banane ko indexing kehte hain. Jab tak index nahi hua, kuchh retrieve nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.A sequence of steps where each one’s out: Steps ka aisa silsila jahan har step ka output agle ka input hai. Ek taraf se documents andar, doosri taraf se jawaab bahar. Chapter 7 mein aap apna banate hain.
hinglish.How long the user waits. Measured in sec: User kitni der wait karta hai. Seconds mein naapa jaata hai, aur yeh technical detail nahi — product decision hai.
hinglish.The wait that 95 out of 100 people get o: Woh wait jo 100 mein se 95 logon ko milta hai ya usse behtar — matlab yeh aapke slow paanchve hisse ke users ki baat karta hai, aam user ki nahi. Average in logon ko chhupa deta hai; design p95 par hota hai.
hinglish.Service-level agreement. A supplier’s wr: Service-level agreement. Supplier ka likhit vaada uptime ya speed ke baare mein, jise todne par nateeja bhi likha ho. Bina nateeje ka vaada marketing claim hai, SLA nahi.
hinglish.Same input, same output, every time. Ord: Wahi input, wahi output, har baar. Aam software deterministic hota hai. Language model nahi hota — is field ki zyadatar hairaani ki jad yahi hai.
hinglish.Coordinating several steps or several mo: Kai steps ya kai models ko is tarah chalana ki woh sahi order mein chalein aur ek doosre ko result de sakein.
hinglish.A named set of categories. In Chapter 14: Categories ka ek naam-diya hua set. Chapter 14 mein iska matlab hai: aapka system kin-kin tareekon se fail hota hai, aapke apne shabdon mein, har ek ke saamne ginti ke saath.
hinglish.The text your app sends to the model — t: Woh text jo aapka app model ko bhejta hai — user ka sawaal, plus uske saath lagi standing instructions. Zyadatar saadi English hoti hai, koi jaadui phrase nahi.
hinglish.A list of numbers. When this course says: Numbers ki ek list. Jab course kehta hai ki text ke tukde ki meaning map par ek "jagah" hai, woh jagah hi vector hai — kuchh sau numbers jo batate hain woh kahan baitha hai. Aap inhe kabhi dekhte nahi.
hinglish.The position a piece of text gets on the: Meaning map par text ke tukde ko milne wali jagah, numbers ki list ke roop mein likhi hui. Ise ek chhota AI banata hai jiska kaam sirf text ko jagah dena hai.
hinglish.One piece of a document after it has bee: Kaate jaane ke baad document ka ek tukda. Yahi unit store, search aur bheja jaata hai.
hinglish.A standing instruction sent invisibly wi: Ek standing instruction jo har message ke saath chupchaap jaati hai, aur batati hai ki AI ko kaisa behave karna hai.
hinglish.The dial deciding whether the AI always: Woh dial jo tay karta hai ki AI hamesha apna sabse likely agla guess le, ya kabhi-kabhi kam likely bhi. Kam ka matlab repeatable hai, sach nahi.
hinglish.When the AI produces something fluent an: Jab AI kuchh fluent aur bana hua nikaal deta hai kyunki uske paas evidence tha hi nahi. Yeh kharaabi nahi — bina jaankaari wale guessing machine ka normal behaviour hai.
hinglish.The answer key: questions with verified: Answer key: sawaal jinke sahi jawaab pehle se verify kiye gaye hon, aur jo test se pehle likhe gaye hon. Iske bina "kya yeh accha hai?" ka koi jawaab hi nahi hai.
hinglish.Continuing a model’s training on your ow: Model ki training aapke apne examples par aage badhana taaki woh ek behaviour apna le. Yeh shape aur register sikhata hai, tikne wale facts nahi. Chapter 19 mein yeh decision hai.
hinglish.A scoring guide written in advance: what: Pehle se likha hua scoring guide: quality ka har level dikhta kaisa hai, taaki ek hi cheez ko do log ek jaisa grade karein.
hinglish.When behaviour changes over time without: Jab behaviour samay ke saath badal jaaye bina kisi ke code chhue — model update ho gaya, corpus bada ho gaya, traffic badal gaya.
hinglish.A record of what the system did and why,: System ne kya kiya aur kyun, iska record, taaki baad mein koi jaanch sake.
hinglish.What the product does when it should not: Jab product ko jawaab nahi dena chahiye tab woh kya karta hai. Ya to soch-samajh kar banaya jaata hai, ya apne aap ho jaata hai.
hinglish.Asking which of two answers is better, i: Do jawaabon mein se behtar poochhna, ek jawaab ko das mein se number dene ki jagah. Yeh zyada bharosemand hai, kyunki log aur models dono compare karne mein grade karne se behtar hain.
hinglish.A grader’s habit of scoring longer answe: Grader ki aadat: lambe jawaab ko zyada number dena, chahe usme extra kuchh kaha hi na gaya ho.
hinglish.A grader’s habit of preferring whichever: Grader ki aadat: jo jawaab pehle dikhaya gaya use pasand karna.
hinglish.What you pay per query on average once t: Jab traffic alag-alag daam wale kai models par bant jaata hai, tab average mein har query par aap kitna dete hain.
hinglish.The share of your input that the provide: Aapke input ka woh hissa jo provider ne pichhli request se pehchan liya aur uske kam paise liye.
hinglish.A model that reads pictures as well as t: Aisa model jo text ke saath tasveerein bhi padhta hai — to aap use extract kiya hua text nahi, seedha page ki image de sakte hain.
hinglish.Software that turns a picture of a page: Software jo page ki tasveer ko text mein badalta hai. Shabd rakh leta hai, layout phenk deta hai.
hinglish.Where things sit on a page — rows, colum: Page par cheezein kahan baithi hain — rows, columns, boxes. Yeh matlab rakhta hai jo plain text mein kho jaata hai.
hinglish.A person talking over the system mid-sen: Jab koi system ke beech mein bol pade. Voice interfaces ko yeh sambhalna padta hai; text wale ismein padte hi nahi.
hinglish.A short document describing what an AI f: Ek chhota document jo batata hai ki AI feature kis kaam ke liye hai, kis number par naapa gaya, kahan fail hota hai, aur kaun check karta hai.
hinglish.Which country your data is physically st: Aapka data physically kis desh mein rakha aur process hota hai.
hinglish.Another company your provider passes you: Woh doosri company jise aapka provider aapka data deta hai. Unka risk ab aapka risk hai.
hinglish.The number a release has to hit before i: Woh number jo release ko ship hone se pehle chhoona hai. Yaani aisa acceptance criterion jisme aankda ho.
hinglish.Releasing to a small slice of users firs: Pehle thode se users ko release karna aur numbers dekhkar aage badhna.
hinglish.Training a small model to copy a large o: Ek chhote model ko ek hi narrow kaam par bade model ki nakal karna sikhana. Quality zyadatar, cost ka chhota hissa.
hinglish.Whether an improvement survives changing: Kya aapka sudhaar provider badalne par bhi bachta hai. Behtar prompt aur index saath jaate hain; tuned model nahi jaata.
hinglish.Naming which kind of wrong you have, wit: Kuchh badalne se pehle yeh naam dena ki galti kis kism ki hai, aur kitni baar hoti hai.
hinglish.What the product promises to show at eac: Product ka vaada ki certainty ke har level par woh kya dikhayega — aur user ko uske baare mein kya karne dega.
hinglish.A source link that opens the exact passa: Aisa source link jo theek wahi passage kholta hai jahan se claim aaya, sirf document ka naam nahi.
hinglish.How a user fixes a wrong output, and wha: User galat output ko kaise theek karta hai, aur woh sudhaar aapke liye kya record karta hai.
hinglish.What the feature still does with the AI: AI wala hissa band kar dene par bhi feature kya-kya karta rehta hai.
hinglish.Optional. Only if you want to run real c: Optional. Sirf tab jab aap asli code chalana chahte hain. Poori tarah optional hai. Har chapter jo sikhata hai woh iske bina bhi sikhata hai, aur har chapter ke andar wale interactive tools ko koi setup chahiye hi nahi. Yeh tab kijiye jab aap wahi ideas asli code mein dekhna chahein.
hinglish.You need a free online coding environmen: Aapko do cheezein chahiye: ek free online coding environment (Google Colab) aur ek free API key (NVIDIA Build) jo aapke programs ko AI models se baat karne deti hai. Pentaalis minute, ek baar, phir hamesha ke liye ho gaya.
hinglish.A1. Google Colab — a free place to run c: A1. Google Colab — code chalane ki ek free jagah
hinglish.Colab is a free service giving you a tem: Colab ek free service hai jo aapko Google ke datacentre mein ek temporary computer deti hai, jise aap browser tab se chalate hain. Aapki machine par kuchh install nahi hota.
hinglish.Go to <code>colab.research.google.com</c: colab.research.google.com kholiye aur kisi bhi Google account se sign in kijiye.
hinglish.You see an empty grey box. That box is a: Aapko ek khaali grey box dikhega. Wahi box ek cell hai — usme instruction likhiye aur chalane ke liye Shift+Enter dabaiye.
hinglish.The word <code>hello</code> appears belo: Cell ke neeche hello shabd aur ek chhota hara tick dikhega. Woh ek program tha. Aapne likha aur chalaya.
hinglish.Cells run top to bottom and remember eac: Cells upar se neeche chalte hain aur ek doosre ko yaad rakhte hain — cell 1 mein banayi gayi value cell 5 mein bhi kaam karti hai, jab tak machine chalu hai.
hinglish.The machine switches off when idle, roug: Machine khaali padi rahe to lagbhag 90 minute mein band ho jaati hai. Aapke likhe cells bache rehte hain; sirf unke results gayab hote hain. Ilaaj: Runtime → Run all. Yeh mausam hai, failure nahi.
hinglish.Rename each notebook by clicking its nam: Har notebook ka naam upar-baayen uske naam par click karke badal dijiye: chapter-1, chapter-2, waghairah.
hinglish.A2. An API key — your access code to the: A2. Ek API key — AI tak pahunchne ka aapka code
hinglish.NVIDIA's Build platform provides free ac: NVIDIA ka Build platform bina credit card ke bahut saare models tak free access deta hai. Is course mein 400 se kaafi kam requests lagti hain; free allowance lagbhag 1,000 hai. Ismein ek line badalkar model swap karna bhi aata hai — sach mein kaam ki skill.
hinglish.Go to <code>build.nvidia.com</code>. Sig: build.nvidia.com kholiye. Kisi bhi email se sign up ya log in kijiye.
hinglish.Search <code>llama-3.1-8b-instruct</code: llama-3.1-8b-instruct search karke uska model page kholiye.
hinglish.Find <strong>Get API Key</strong> (on so: Get API Key dhoondhiye (kuchh pages par: Build with this NIM → Generate Key). Us par click kijiye.
hinglish.A long code beginning <code>nvapi-</code: nvapi- se shuru hone wala ek lamba code dikhega. Use turant kahin private jagah copy kar lijiye — password manager ya private note mein. Ise ATM PIN ki tarah samajhiye.
hinglish.Why this matters professionally: Yeh professionally kyun maayne rakhta hai
hinglish.Keys embedded in code get copied, shared: Code ke andar likhi keys copy hoti hain, share hoti hain, aur leak ho jaati hain — software ki sabse aam security galtiyon mein se ek. Inhe theek se rakhna aata ho, aur kyun rakhna hai yeh pata ho, yeh khud meeting-level jaankaari hai.
hinglish.A3. Storing the key so it is not visible: A3. Key ko aise rakhna ki woh dikhe nahi
API key kabhi code cell mein paste mat kijiye. Colab mein isi kaam ke liye ek secrets locker hai.
hinglish.Click the key icon (🔑) in the left sideb: Baayen sidebar mein key icon (🔑) par click kijiye.
+ Add new secret par click kijiye. Name: bilkul NVIDIA_API_KEY. Value: aapka nvapi-… code.
hinglish.<code>Key loaded, starts with: nvapi-xx<: Key loaded, starts with: nvapi-xx — sirf pehle 8 characters dikhane se poori key screen par nahi aati.
hinglish.A few progress lines, then silence. Sile: Kuchh progress lines, phir chuppi. Chuppi hi safalta hai.
hinglish.One note worth filing: the library is ca: Ek baat note kar lijiye: library ka naam openai hai, lekin hum OpenAI ki service istemaal nahi kar rahe. OpenAI ne pehla widely-adopted request format publish kiya tha aur zyadatar industry ne wahi copy kar liya. Isliye ek hi library kai providers ke saath chalti hai. Aage provider badalna sirf ek line ka kaam ho sakta hai — theek wahi kism ka architectural fact jo vendor ki baithak mein izzat dilata hai.
hinglish.A5. Collect your raw material: A5. Apna raw material jama kijiye
hinglish.Create one folder in Google Drive named: Google Drive mein my-corpus naam ka ek folder banaiye. Usme apne kaam ke 10–15 aise documents daaliye jinhe aap gehraai se jaante hain: policies, SOPs, product manuals, contracts, handbooks, published standards.
hinglish.Why your own documents matter: Aapke apne documents kyun zaroori hain
hinglish.The second half of this book builds a sy: Is course ka doosra hissa aisa system banata hai jo aapke corpus se sawaalon ke jawaab deta hai. Jab woh galat jawaab dega — aur dega — aapko galti turant pakadni hai, bina kisi ki madad ke. Aapka domain knowledge hi aapka quality-control department hai. Anjaan documents ke saath aapko ek expert bulana padta; apne documents ke saath expert aap hain.
hinglish.<strong>For Part II, add deliberately aw: Part II ke liye jaanbujhkar mushkil material bhi daaliye: kam se kam do scanned pages, ek document jisme asli table ho, aur — agar ho sake — kisi policy ka purana version uske naye version ke saath. Chapter 12 aur 16 ko yeh chahiye, aur bahut saaf corpus aapko yeh sikha dega ki sab kuchh theek chalta hai.
hinglish.A6. Part II additions: A6. Part II ke liye extra
hinglish.Before Chapter 9, confirm your model cat: Chapter 9 se pehle dekh lijiye ki aapke model catalogue mein yeh sab hain. Inme se koi na ho, to us chapter ke If Something Goes Wrong mein uska rasta likha hai.
hinglish.A <strong>tool-calling</strong> capable: Ek tool-calling kar sakne wala instruct model (Ch. 9)
hinglish.A <strong>reasoning</strong> model, or s: Ek reasoning model, ya bas do model jinke size aur daam saaf alag hon (Ch. 11)
hinglish.A model supporting <code>response_format: Ek model jo response_format / JSON schema support karta ho (Ch. 8) — validation loop iska fallback hai
hinglish.Sidebar 🔑 → toggle ON for this notebook: Sidebar 🔑 → is notebook ke liye ON kijiye → key wala cell dobara chalaiye
hinglish.Exact strings only — copy from the model: Bilkul exact string chahiye — build.nvidia.com ke model page se copy kijiye
hinglish.Loop hit the per-minute rate limit: Loop per-minute rate limit se takra gaya
hinglish.Add <code>import time; time.sleep(2)</co: Loop ke andar import time; time.sleep(2) daal dijiye
hinglish.<code>extra_body={\"input_type\": …}</co: Embedding model ke liye extra_body={"input_type": …} zaroori hai
hinglish.Note the exact red text, close, return w: Laal text jaisa hai waisa likh lijiye, band kijiye, kal taazi nazar se wapas aaiye
hinglish.What actually happens when your app asks: Jab aapka app AI se kuchh poochhta hai to asal mein hota kya hai, woh cheezein banata kyun hai, documents kaise kaate aur dobara dhoondhe jaate hain, aur yeh kaise pata chale ki kuchh kaam bhi kar raha hai.
hinglish.Ten minutes. Nothing to install, nothing: Das minute. Kuchh install nahi karna, kahin sign up nahi karna, aur pehle se kuchh aata ho yeh maan kar nahi chala gaya hai.
hinglish.Tell the difference between the app and: App aur model ka farq bata paana — design ki baatcheet mein tik paane ka zyadatar hissa yahi hai.
hinglish.Know that you can tap any underlined wor: Yeh pata hona ki kisi bhi underline shabd par tap karke uska matlab dekha ja sakta hai, page chhode bina.
hinglish.Most people who give up on a technical s: Technical vishay chhodne wale zyadatar log isliye nahi chhodte ki woh mushkil tha. Woh isliye chhodte hain ki page teen par ek shabd nikal gaya jo baaki sabko samajh aa raha tha, aur rukne ki jagah unhone padhna jaari rakha — har paragraph mein thoda kam samajh mein aata gaya, jab tak poori cheez kisi aur ke liye likhi hui na lagne lagi.
hinglish.If that has happened to you before, it w: Agar aapke saath pehle aisa hua hai, to galti likhne wale ki thi, aapki nahi. Yahan do cheezein isi ko rokne ke liye banayi gayi hain.
hinglish.<strong>Every word is tappable.</strong>: Har shabd tappable hai. Jab bhi koi aisa term pehli baar aata hai jiska koi khaas matlab hai, uske neeche halki dotted line aa jaati hai. Us par tap kijiye, aur saaf-saaf matlab wahin dikh jaayega — aapko page chhodna nahi padta aur jagah nahi khoti.
hinglish.Try it on this sentence, which contains: Isi sentence par try kijiye, ismein chaar hain: ek app ek prompt ek model ko bhejta hai aur bill tokens mein banta hai. Aage padhne se pehle abhi har ek par tap kijiye. Kuchh kahenge you build this in Chapter 9 — matlab course ne use jaanbujhkar jaldi naam de diya hai, aur ek line wala matlab hi abhi kaafi hai.
hinglish.Now write it back, roughly. What is the: Ab ise apne shabdon mein wapas likhiye, motamoti. App aur model mein farq kya hai? Do line. Yahan aadha galat hone se kuchh nahi bigadta — bataye jaane se pehle likhna hi to poora point hai.
hinglish.The model is a program on somebody else’: Model kisi aur ke computers par chalne wala ek program hai jo text leta hai aur text lautata hai. Na koi button, na memory, na yeh andaaza ki koi insaan hai. App aapka product hai — woh screens aur code jo tay karte hain ki model ko kya bhejna hai aur jawaab ka kya karna hai. User jise “AI” samajhta hai, woh asal mein aapka app hai jo ek narrow kaam karne wale model ke aas-paas sab kuchh sambhal raha hai. In dono ko alag rakh paana hi zyadatar farq hai us product manager mein jo design ki baat kar sakta hai aur us mein jo nahi kar sakta.
hinglish.<strong>The second thing: this course st: Doosri cheez: yeh course rukta hai aur poochhta hai. Har kuchh paragraph baad ek box aata hai, waisa hi jaisa abhi aapne istemaal kiya. Kuchh aapse pehle guess karwate hain. Kuchh likhwate hain. Kuchh asli sawaal hain jo count hote hain.
hinglish.They exist because reading and understan: Yeh isliye hain kyunki andar se padhna aur samajhna ek jaisa hi lagta hai, lekin sach sirf ek hota hai. Aur galat hona sahi hone se zyada kaam ka hai — jis jawaab par aapko bharosa tha aur woh galat nikla, usne aapki ek aisi soch pakad li jo aapko galat lagti hi nahi thi. Padhai ki baithak mein isse behtar kuchh nahi hota. Yeh sab kisi ko dikhta nahi. Na koi grade hai, na pass marks.
hinglish.That is all you need to use this. A few: Ise istemaal karne ke liye bas itna hi chahiye. Kuchh practical baatein, phir Chapter 1.
hinglish.<strong>Nothing to install.</strong> The: Kuchh install nahi karna. Har chapter ke interactive tools yahin page ke andar chalte hain. Kuchh chapters mein ek optional section hai jo wahi ideas asli code mein dikhata hai — uske liye ek free account aur bees minute ka setup chahiye, aur aap use poori tarah chhod sakte hain. Aage kuchh bhi us par tika nahi hai.
hinglish.<strong>One chapter per sitting.</strong: Ek baithak mein ek chapter. Har ek pandrah se pachchees minute ka hai. Energy bachi rehte hue rukna hi aapko kal wapas laata hai; pehle hafte mein sab kuchh aur uske baad kuchh nahi — yeh iska aam ant hai.
hinglish.<strong>Your progress follows you.</stro: Aapki progress aapke saath chalti hai. Sign in hone par sab kuchh aapke account mein save hota hai, to aap phone par padh sakte hain aur desk par aage badha sakte hain.
hinglish.You will hit a chapter that feels too ha: Ek na ek chapter aapko bahut mushkil lagega. Yeh planned hai, koi apwaad nahi. Tab na to zabardasti aage badhna hai aur na rukna hai — tab sabse chhota available kadam uthaiye aur din wahin khatam kar dijiye. Har sawaal ke saath ek “Stuck?” button hai jo aapko jawaab dikha deta hai, bina uske aapke against gine.
hinglish.When I do not want to open this, I will: Jab man na kare kholne ka, tab main …
hinglish.Decide it now, while it is easy to think: Abhi tay kar lijiye, jab saaf sochna aasaan hai. Jis shaam aapka man is app ko kholne ka nahi hoga, tab aap kya karenge? Sabse chhota kaam kya hai jo tab bhi aap kar lenge — aur chhoote hue din ke baare mein aap apne aap ko kya kahenge?
hinglish.The plans that survive a bad evening sha: Jo plan kharaab shaam mein bhi tikte hain unme teen cheezein common hoti hain. Sabse chhota kadam sach mein bahut chhota hota hai — ek sawaal, do minute, poora chapter nahi. Aapko pata hota hai ki wapas kahan se shuru karna hai, kyunki thake hue sabse mehnga kaam decide karna hi hota hai. Aur chhoote hue din ki kahani pehle se tay hoti hai: chhoota din bas chhoota din hai. Woh kisi baat ka sabooot nahi hai aur uska matlab dobara shuru karna nahi hai. Sabse lapse hota hai. Poora karne wale wahi log hain jinhone pehle hi tay kar liya tha ki lapse allowed hai.
hinglish.That is the whole chapter. Nothing here: Bas itna hi chapter hai. Yahan kuchh yaad rakhne layak nahi hai. Chapter 1 se asli shuruaat hai.
hinglish.What happens when your app asks an AI so: Jab aapka app AI se kuchh poochhta hai to hota kya hai
hinglish.Three facts about the machine. Each one: Machine ke teen facts. Har ek aisi cheez tay karta hai jiske aas-paas aapko design karna padega.
hinglish.Explain why an AI can sound completely c: Yeh samjha paana ki AI poore confidence ke saath bilkul galat kaise ho sakta hai.
hinglish.Say what a company is actually billed fo: Yeh batana ki jab koi AI feature istemaal karta hai to company ka bill asal mein kis cheez ka banta hai.
hinglish.Explain why a long chat costs more per m: Yeh samjhana ki lambi chat mein har message chhoti chat se mehnga kyun padta hai — aur yeh technical detail nahi, product decision kyun hai.
hinglish.Start with your phone keyboard. You type: Apne phone ke keyboard se shuru kijiye. Aap likhte hain See you at the aur woh sujhaata hai office, station, airport. Woh log aam taur par kya likhte hain, usi pattern se agla shabd guess kar raha hai. Aapki shaam ke baare mein soch nahi raha.
hinglish.An AI model is that, made enormous. It w: AI model wahi cheez hai, bas bahut badi. Use bahut saara likha hua padhwakar ek hi narrow trick mein bahut maahir banaya gaya hai: agla text kya aayega, yeh guess karna. Yeh trick baar-baar kijiye aur poore paragraph nikal aate hain. Sach mein bas itna hi karta hai.
hinglish.It is guessing, not looking up. There is: Yeh guess kar raha hai, dhoondh nahi raha. Iske peechhe koi database nahi hai jise yeh dekhta ho. Is field ki zyadatar hairaani ki jad yahi ek fact hai.
hinglish.One line — what do you think it does?: Ek line — aapko kya lagta hai yeh kya karega?
hinglish.So: you ask it about a refund policy at: To: aap ise ek aisi company ki refund policy ke baare mein poochhte hain jo hai hi nahi. Usne uske baare mein kabhi kuchh dekha hi nahi. Kya wapas aayega?
hinglish.This is why you cannot judge an AI answe: Isiliye aap AI ke jawaab ko uske confident lehje se nahi jaanch sakte. Dono haalat mein woh bilkul ek jaisa sunai deta hai. Chapter 2 poora isi par hai.
hinglish.A confident, well-written, completely in: Ek confident, achchhi tarah likhi hui, poori tarah bana di gayi policy. Isliye nahi ki woh jhooth bol raha hai — balki isliye ki “agla text guess karo” mein “mere paas kuchh nahi hai” wala option hai hi nahi. Mujhe nahi pata kehna ek behaviour hai jo upar se jodna padta hai, aur woh hamesha tikta bhi nahi.
hinglish.Now the practical part: what actually ge: Ab practical hissa: asal mein bheja kya jaata hai, aur paisa kis cheez ka lagta hai.
hinglish.Your app sends text. The AI sends text b: Aapka app text bhejta hai. AI text wapas bhejta hai. Bill dono ka banta hai — kitna andar gaya, aur kitna bahar aaya. Lekin shabd ke hisaab se nahi. Usse thodi chhoti cheez ke hisaab se.
hinglish.Text gets chopped into pieces called <st: Text ko tukdon mein kaat diya jaata hai jinhe tokens kehte hain. Motamoti, ek token ek English word ka teen-chauthai hota hai. Aam shabd aksar ek-ek token hote hain; anokhe shabd aur doosri lipiyan kai tukdon mein toot jaate hain. Khud dekhiye — yeh asli cheez hai, yahin chal rahi hai:
hinglish.Type a normal sentence and watch it spli: Ek normal sentence likhiye aur use tootte hue dekhiye. Phir apna naam likhiye, aur phir Hindi ya Tamil mein kuchh, agar aata ho. Dhyaan dijiye ki unke kitne zyada tukde bante hain. Har extra tukda paisa hai.
hinglish.Second fact: there is a size limit. Ever: Doosra fact: ek size limit hai. Ek baar mein bheji gayi har cheez — sawaal, saath lagi instructions, koi bhi documents, aur wapas aane wala jawaab — sab ek ceiling ke andar aana chahiye. Industry us ceiling ko context window kehti hai.
hinglish.It is worth being precise about what it: Yeh saaf kar lena zaroori hai ki yeh kya nahi hai. Yeh memory nahi hai. Yeh ek delivery ka size hai.
hinglish.Which brings us to the third fact, and t: Aur isse teesra fact aata hai, jo sabse ajeeb hai.
hinglish.The AI forgets you completely the moment: Jawaab dete hi AI aapko poori tarah bhool jaata hai. Har request shoonya se shuru hoti hai. Use andaaza bhi nahi ki ek minute pehle aap usse baat kar rahe the.
hinglish.That raises an obvious question: so how: To ek seedha sawaal uthta hai: phir chat assistant ko paanch message pehle ki baat yaad kaise rehti hai?
hinglish.It does not. The app re-sends the entire: Rehti nahi hai. App har baar poori conversation dobara bhejta hai. Jab aap chhatha message likhte hain, app chupchaap message ek se paanch bhi saath bhej deta hai, taaki jawaab mein matlab bane. Yeh memory app ka kiya hua khel hai, AI ka gun nahi.
hinglish.And since you pay for everything you sen: Aur kyunki aap jo bhejte hain uska paisa dete hain — woh poora history har message par dobara aapke bill mein aata hai. Hote hue dekhiye:

Yeh galat ho jaaye to quality chupchaap girti hai — kuchh tootta nahi, bas results kharaab hote hain, aur kisi ko dikhta nahi kyun.
hinglish.<strong>The map is only as good as whoev: Naksha utna hi achcha hai jitna use banane wala. Woh text padhkar bana hai — zyadatar internet ki English. hinglish.In our domain the map would get … wrong,: Hamare domain mein naksha … ko galat samjhega, kyunki …
hinglish.Find where it will fail you. Your actual: Dhoondhiye ki yeh aapke liye kahan fail hoga. Aapka asli domain, aapke asli users. Zyadatar English internet text se bana naksha kin do cheezon ko paas rakh dega jinhe aapke users bilkul alag maante hain — ya kin do cheezon ko door kar dega jinka aapke users ke liye matlab ek hi hai?
hinglish.Indian financial and legal vocabulary is: Bhartiya financial aur legal vocabulary inse bhari hai: lakh aur crore, NEFT versus IMPS, sarkari scheme ke naam jo ek shabd alag hote hain aur raqam mein zameen-aasmaan. English akshron mein likhi regional bhaashaayein — paisa kab milega — ek aur misaal hain. Aur internal cheezein bhi: do product codenames aapke liye alag-alag hain aur naksha ke liye kuchh bhi nahi, to woh unhe spelling se jagah de deta hai. Aapko yeh samajh aaya ya nahi, iska imtihaan yeh hai ki user se pehle aap failure ka naam le paate hain ya nahi.
hinglish.This technique is the foundation of near: Yeh technique lagbhag har us "chat with your documents" product ki neev hai jo aapko kabhi dikhaya jaayega. Yeh sach mein achchi hai. Lekin dhyaan dijiye yeh ab bhi kya nahi karti: yeh hamesha sabse paas ke tukde deti hai, tab bhi jab kuchh paas hai hi nahi. Chapter 4 ki dikkat kahin gayi nahi hai. Isiliye agla chapter naapne ke baare mein hai, aur isiliye woh Part I ka sabse zaroori chapter hai.
hinglish.How to know if it actually works: Yeh kaise pata chale ki kaam kar bhi raha hai
hinglish.Turning “the demo looked good” into a nu: "Demo achcha laga" ko us number mein badalna jo aapne khud nikaala hai. Yahi chapter aapko kaam ka banata hai.
hinglish.Explain what a company must build before: Yeh samjhana ki koi company imaandaari se accuracy number batane se pehle kya banaye.
hinglish.Describe the two ways a search step fail: Search step ke do failure batana, aur yeh ki ek theek karne se doosra kyun bigadta hai.
hinglish.Say which of those failures is fatal for: Yeh kehna ki aapke feature ke liye inme se kaunsa failure jaanleva hai — aur us chunav ko defend karna.
hinglish.It hands back a ranked list whatever you: Aap kuchh bhi poochhein, woh ek ranked list thama deta hai.
hinglish.Meaning matching finds near neighbours: Meaning matching paas ke padosi dhoondhta hai
hinglish.Which is not the same as finding the rig: Jo sahi jawaab dhoondhne ke barabar nahi hai.
hinglish.Every AI project reaches the same moment: Har AI project ek hi mod par pahunchta hai. Koi senior poochhta hai: yeh achcha hai kya? Aur zyadatar organisations mein jawaab ek demo hota hai — teen sawaal jo chalte hain, poore confidence ke saath dikhaye gaye. Woh jawaab nahi hai. Woh performance hai.
hinglish.The machinery for answering properly is: Theek se jawaab dene ki machinery na nayi hai na technical. Agar aapne kabhi acceptance criteria likhe hain, to yeh samajh aapke paas pehle se hai. Yeh teen ideas hain.
hinglish.<strong>One: write the answers down befo: Ek: test se pehle jawaab likh lijiye. Aap system ko cheezein poochhkar aur jo aaye us par sar hilakar nahi jaanch sakte — aap har plausible cheez par sar hila denge, kyunki plausible hi to woh banata hai. To pehle aap asli sawaalon ki list banaiye, unke verified sahi jawaabon ke saath. Us list ko ground truth kehte hain, aur woh bas ek answer key hai, imtihaan se pehle likhi hui.
hinglish.Ten to thirty questions is enough to sta: Shuru karne ke liye das se tees sawaal kaafi hain. Woh asli hone chahiye, un shabdon mein jo users sach mein istemaal karte hain — aise sawaal nahi jo aapne documents padhne ke baad likhe, kyunki woh documents ki hi vocabulary istemaal karenge aur chupchaap kuchh bhi test nahi karenge.
hinglish.You build a search step, write ten hones: Aap ek search step banate hain, das imaandaar sawaal likhte hain, aur chalate hain. Pehli koshish mein kitne sahi tukda dhoondh paayenge?
hinglish.And if you got nine or ten, the likelies: Aur agar nau ya das aaye, to sabse likely wajah yeh nahi hai ki aapka system zabardast hai. Wajah yeh hai ki aapne sawaal documents padhne ke baad likhe, to aapne yeh test kiya ki aapka search apne hi shabdon se text dhoondh paata hai ya nahi. Woh aaina hai, test nahi.
hinglish.Six or seven out of ten is a normal, hea: Das mein se chhah ya saat pehla nateeja normal aur sehatmand hai. Sach mein — pehle din chalte hue system ka yahi roop hota hai.
hinglish.This also gives you the single most usef: Isse aapko woh ek sabse kaam ka sawaal bhi mil jaata hai jo aap kisi bhi number batane wale vendor se poochh sakte hain. "94% kaise aaya?" nahi, balki: kis answer key ke against, kisne likhi thi, aur kya main sawaal dekh sakta hoon? Zyadatar dikha nahi paate. Wahi aapka jawaab hai.
hinglish.<strong>Two: there are two ways to fail,: Do: fail hone ke do tareeke hain, aur woh ek doosre ko kheenchte hain. Sochiye ki aapne kisi assistant se meeting se judi files mangwayin. Woh do tareeke se fail ho sakta hai: kaam ki cheez chhod de, ya bekaar cheezon ka dher laga de.
hinglish.Leaving out what mattered is called poor: Kaam ki cheez chhod dena kamzor recall kehlata hai. Bekaar cheezon ka dher lagana kamzor precision. Dono ke beech ka lever yeh hai ki har sawaal par kitne tukde nikaale jaayein — ise aam taur par k likhte hain. Zyada nikaaliye to kam chhootega, lekin jo aaya usme kachra zyada hoga. Kam nikaaliye to jo aaya woh sab kaam ka hoga, lekin cheezein chhootengi.
hinglish.You cannot have both. Move the lever and: Dono ek saath nahi mil sakte. Lever hilakar dekhiye:
hinglish.<strong>Three: which failure is worse de: Teen: kaunsa failure zyada bura hai, yeh poori tarah is par nirbhar hai ki aap kya bana rahe hain. Aur yahin yeh engineering ka sawaal rehta hi nahi.
hinglish.A customer-facing bot that answers polic: Grahakon ko policy ke jawaab dene wala bot: ismein bekaar cheezon ka dher jaanleva hai, kyunki usi bekaar material se AI phir poore confidence ke saath galat jawaab bana deta hai — aur grahak ko batayi gayi galat policy ek liability hai. Jawaab chhoot jaaye to bas ek support ticket banta hai.
hinglish.A tool helping a lawyer research precede: Wakeel ko precedents dhoondhne mein madad karne wala tool: bilkul ulta. Chhoota hua precedent case hara sakta hai. Ek extra bekaar precedent tees second ka scanning hai.
hinglish.Nobody can make that call for you. It de: Yeh faisla aapke liye koi nahi kar sakta. Yeh is par nirbhar hai ki har failure hone par kisi asli insaan ka kya bigadta hai, aur yeh samajhne wala woh hai jiska product hai — jisne banaya woh nahi.
hinglish.For … the fatal failure is … because … s: … ke liye jaanleva failure … hai kyunki … isliye main k = … se shuru karunga
hinglish.Make the call. For something you actuall: Faisla lijiye. Kisi aisi cheez ke liye jis par aap sach mein kaam karte hain: kaunsa failure sasta hai aur kaunsa jaanleva? Kyun, yeh is hisaab se batayiye ki asli user ka kya hota hai — phir motamoti batayiye ki shuruaat mein aap kitne tukde nikaalenge.
hinglish.A strong answer ties the choice to a con: Achcha jawaab chunav ko pasand se nahi, nateeje se jodta hai. Roop yeh hai: "Hamare support assistant ke liye bekaar cheez aa jaana jaanleva hai, kyunki grahak ko batayi gayi galat policy ek liability ban jaati hai jise phir nibhana padta hai, jabki jawaab chhoot jaane par sirf woh ticket banta hai jo waise bhi aa raha tha. Isliye pehle precision, kam k, aur ek saaf raasta ki woh keh sake ki use nahi pata." Number se zyada tark maayne rakhta hai. Number koi bhi chun sakta hai. Use defend karna hi hunar hai.
hinglish.That is the chapter, and it is the one t: Bas yahi chapter hai, aur yahi woh chapter hai jo logon ka aapke prati rawaiya badal deta hai. AI ki baatcheet mein lagbhag kisi ke paas answer key nahi hoti. Ek baar aapke paas ho, to aap kamre mein akele aise insaan hain jo bata sakta hai ki kuchh kaam kar raha hai ya nahi — aur aap ise apne nikaale hue number ke saath keh sakte hain.
hinglish.Nothing new here. You have already built: Yahan naya kuchh nahi. Aap har hissa pehle hi bana chuke hain — yahan use uska naam milta hai aur aap dekhte hain ki woh kahan tootta hai.
hinglish.Draw the standard architecture behind al: Lagbhag har "chat with your documents" product ke peechhe ka standard architecture bana paana.
hinglish.Point at each step and say what can go w: Har step par ungli rakhkar batana ki wahan kya galat ho sakta hai bina kisi cheez ke fail dikhe.
hinglish.Rank the usual fixes by how much they ac: Aam ilaajon ko is hisaab se rank karna ki woh sach mein kitni madad karte hain — aur yeh jaanna ki popular jawaab aksar galat kyun hai.
Size limit aur bill ki wajah se.
hinglish.Meaning matching finds relevant pieces: Meaning matching kaam ke tukde dhoondhta hai
Naksha par jagah se, common shabdon se nahi.
hinglish.An answer key is how you know it works: Answer key hi batati hai ki yeh kaam karta hai
Aur yeh bhi ki aapne kaunsa failure chuna hai.
hinglish.There is a name this course has kept fro: Ek naam hai jo yeh course chhah chapter tak aapse chhupaye rakha. Aapne use kama liya hai.
hinglish.What you have built is: cut documents in: Aapne jo banaya hai woh yeh hai: documents ko tukdon mein kaato, har tukde ko meaning map par ek jagah do, sawaal ke sabse paas wale tukde dhoondho, un tukdon ko sawaal ke saath AI ko bhejo, aur unhi par tika hua jawaab lo — bana hua nahi.
hinglish.That is called <strong>RAG</strong> — re: Ise RAG kehte hain — retrieval-augmented generation. Generation Chapter 1 ki text machine hai. Retrieval se augmented Chapter 4 aur 5 hai. Applied AI mein sabse zyada deploy hone wala pattern yahi hai, aur lagbhag har us product ke peechhe yahi hai jo aapke documents par sawaalon ke jawaab dene ka daawa karta hai.
hinglish.You will see it drawn on vendor slides w: Aap ise vendor slides par chamakte hexagons ke saath bana hua dekhenge. Ab aap har hexagon bana chuke hain, kai to haath se, aur zyadatar ko tod bhi chuke hain.
hinglish.Close this and write it out from memory: Ise band kijiye aur yaad se numbered list mein likhiye — document aane se lekar user tak jawaab pahunchne tak. Phir har us step ke aage star lagaiye jahan galat jawaab ban sakta hai bina kisi cheez ke toote dikhe.
hinglish.The steps: cut into pieces → give each a: Steps: tukdon mein kaato → har ek ko jagah do → store karo → sawaal ko jagah do → sabse paas ke tukde dhoondho → unhe sawaal ke saath bhejo → jawaab banao → sources ke saath dikhao. Lagbhag har ek chupchaap fail hota hai. Kaatne se rule aur uska exception alag ho jaate hain, aur kahin error nahi aata. Search un sawaalon ke liye bhi top result deta hai jinka jawaab aapke documents mein hai hi nahi, aur kahin error nahi aata. AI ek bekaar tukde se fluent jawaab likh deta hai, aur kahin error nahi aata. Is machine ki pehchaan yahi hai: yeh crash nahi hoti. Yeh bas chupchaap galat ho jaati hai, jab ki har component success report karta rehta hai.
hinglish.So when someone tells you their AI assis: To jab koi aapse kahe ki unka AI assistant kharaab jawaab de raha hai, to "kharaab jawaab" koi diagnosis nahi hai. Kam se kam chaar alag samasyaein hain jo bahar se ek jaisi dikhti hain, aur unke ilaaj bilkul alag hain. Har ek kahan rehti hai, yeh dekhiye:
hinglish.Your ranking, biggest impact first: Aapki ranking, sabse zyada asar wala pehle
hinglish.Someone gives you one quarter to make an: Koi aapko jawaab ki quality sudhaarne ke liye ek quarter deta hai. Aage padhne se pehle inhe rank kijiye: zyada mehnga AI model, behtar kaatna, results ko dobara rank karne wala ek second pass, instructions par aur mehnat, khud documents ko saaf karna.
hinglish.That is the general rule, and it will se: Yeh aam niyam hai, aur yeh saalon tak kaam aayega: aise system mein quality ki dikkat model ki dikkat se kahin zyada baar evidence ki dikkat hoti hai. Paisa wahan lagaiye jahan evidence hai.
hinglish.Cleaning the documents and fixing how th: Documents saaf karna aur kaatne ka tareeka theek karna lagbhag hamesha jeette hain, aur uske baad re-ranking pass sabse sasta bada sudhaar hai. Zyada mehnga model aam taur par sabse mehnga option hai aur sabse chhota faayda — kyunki dikkat kabhi yeh thi hi nahi ki AI padh nahi paa raha tha. Dikkat yeh thi ki sahi evidence us tak pahuncha hi nahi.
hinglish.Why keep the name back for six chapters?: Naam chhah chapter tak kyun rok kar rakha? Kyunki cheez se pehle seekha gaya shabd jargon ban jaata hai — jise aap doharaa to sakte hain lekin defend nahi kar sakte. Cheez ke baad seekha gaya shabd gawahi ban jaata hai. Ab se jab aap RAG bolenge, to woh koi uthaya hua term nahi hoga. Woh ek cheez hogi jo aapne banayi hai, aur usse bhi zyada kaam ki baat — jise aapne toda hai.
hinglish.A close approximation of how models spli: Models text kaise kaatte hain, uska kaafi paas ka roop. Exact boundaries model ke hisaab se badalti hain; ratio nahi badalta. Dhyaan dijiye kaunse shabd saabut bachte hain aur kaunse bikhar jaate hain — aur ek sentence doosri bhaasha mein bhi try kijiye.
hinglish.Why message 50 costs more than message 1: Message 50 message 1 se mehnga kyun padta hai
hinglish.The stage trick, metered. Each turn re-s: Woh stage wala khel, meter ke saath. Har turn apne se pehle ka sab kuchh dobara bhejta hai, isliye cost conversation ke square ke hisaab se badhti hai — messages ki ginti ke hisaab se nahi.
hinglish.Real sampling mathematics on a fixed can: Ek tay candidate set par asli sampling ka ganit. 0 par sabse upar wala continuation har baar jeetta hai; badhaiye to distribution phailta jaata hai jab tak kam-likely cheez aam na ho jaaye.
hinglish.Scissors, with a damage report: Kainchi, nuksaan ki report ke saath
hinglish.Paste your own document. The orphan test: Apna document paste kijiye. Orphan test un chunks ko pakadta hai jo back-reference se shuru hote hain; boundary test unhe jo beech sentence mein shuru ya khatam hote hain. Chapter 3 aapse yahi do chotein haath se dhoondhne ko kehta hai.
hinglish.A two-dimensional stand-in for a 1024-di: 1024-dimension wale naksha ka do-dimension wala roop, jisme padoas waise hi rakhe gaye hain jaise ek asli embedding model banata hai. Koi bhi do terms chuniye; cosine live nikalta hai, bilkul waise hi jaise chapter ki ek line ke code mein.
hinglish.Nine answerable questions with the corre: Nau aise sawaal jinke jawaab hain, aur sahi chunks realistic gehraai par rakhe hue. k hilaiye aur dekhiye recall chadhta hai jabki precision — aur aapka bill — doosri taraf jaate hain. Applied AI ka sabse zyada dikhaya jaane wala chart, ek slider se bana hua.
hinglish.The trap you build yourself: Woh jaal jo aap khud banate hain
hinglish.Twenty simulated extractions against a d: Bees simulated extractions, ek aise document par jisme koi amount hai hi nahi. Dekhiye ki ek schema decision par invention rate kaise badalta hai — yaani model ke paas "maujood nahi hai" kehne ka proper raasta hai ya nahi.
hinglish.The whole of agency: model asks, your co: Poori agency yahi hai: model maangta hai, aapka code chalta hai, result wapas jaata hai. Ek baar mein ek cheez todiye aur dekhiye kaunsa failure milta hai — us sabse zaroori failure samet, jisme agent aisi safalta sunata hai jo hui hi nahi.
hinglish.Recovery rate by depth, following the cu: Gehraai ke hisaab se recovery rate, us curve par jo yeh models sach mein dikhate hain: kinaron par mazboot, beech mein dhalta hua, aur context bada hone par aur kharaab. Dhyaan dijiye ki ceiling kabhi aati hi nahi — girawat capacity se bahut pehle aa jaati hai.
hinglish.Stable first, volatile last: Sthir pehle, badalne wala baad mein
hinglish.The same tokens, the same answer, two or: Wahi tokens, wahi jawaab, do order. Inme se sirf ek cacheable hai — jisse envelope ka order style ka nahi, cost ka decision ban jaata hai.
hinglish.Two task types, two settings. The asymme: Do kism ke kaam, do settings. Poora chapter isi asamaanta mein hai: lookups par aap kai guna paisa dete hain bina kuchh paaye, aur sach mein multi-step kaam par kabhi-kabhi aap ekmatra sahi jawaab kharid lete hain.
hinglish.Reciprocal rank fusion on a live example: Ek live example par reciprocal rank fusion. Woh exact-string query try kijiye jahan semantic search laDkhaDa jaata hai aur keyword search bemisaal hai — phir dekhiye fusion dono ki taakat rakh leta hai, bina aapse chunwaaye.
hinglish.Ten injected questions against each defe: Har defence ke against das injected sawaal. Do cheezein dekhiye: koi defence zero tak nahi pahunchta, aur adaptive attack — jo khaas aapke defence ke liye likha gaya hai — seedha wapas upar chadh jaata hai. Filter deewaar nahi hota.
hinglish.Three questions about any AI system in y: Aapke organisation ke kisi bhi AI system ke baare mein teen sawaal. Imaandaari se jawaab dijiye. Teen haan ka matlab exfiltration channel hai, chahe vendor ka security page kuchh bhi kahe.
hinglish.The same three correct claims, padded wi: Wahi teen sahi baatein, hedging aur structure se bhari hui. Content bilkul nahi badalta. Dekhiye ek naadaan judge us bharaav ko inaam deta hai — phir aise rubric par jaiye jo score ki jagah unsupported claim maangta hai.
hinglish.Start with the naive estimate everyone p: Us naadaan estimate se shuru kijiye jo sab business case mein daalte hain, phir woh chaar cheezein on kijiye jo hamesha chhoot jaati hain. Neeche jo ratio hai, wahi number budget meeting mein le jaana hai.
hinglish.What real systems add: Asli systems mein kya judta hai
hinglish.Getting answers in a fixed shape, lettin: Jawaab ek tay shape mein lena, use kaam karne dena, size limit, use pehle sochne ka paisa dena, behtar search — aur woh attack jiska koi ilaaj nahi.
hinglish.Making it fill in a form instead of writ: Prose likhwane ki jagah form bharwana
hinglish.Prose is for people. The moment software: Prose insaanon ke liye hai. Jaise hi software ko jawaab par kaam karna ho, aapko fields chahiye — aur vinamrata se maangne se kaam nahi chalta.
hinglish.Explain why \"97% of the time it returns: Ganit ke saath samjhana ki "97% baar sahi data aata hai" fail hone wala number kyun hai.
hinglish.Say what a schema guarantees and — more: Yeh batana ki schema kya guarantee karta hai aur — isse zyada zaroori — kya nahi karta.
hinglish.Turn a complaint like \"it keeps making: "Yeh amounts banata rehta hai" jaisi shikaayat ko aisi field definition mein badalna jisse banana namumkin ho jaaye.
hinglish.It guesses the next piece of text: Yeh text ka agla tukda guess karta hai
hinglish.So what comes back is whatever looked mo: To jo wapas aata hai woh sabse plausible dikhne wali cheez hai, kisi bhi shape mein.
hinglish.An instruction discourages, it does not: Instruction rokta nahi, sirf hatotsahit karta hai
hinglish.You proved this by breaking your own gua: Aapne apna hi guardrail todkar yeh saabit kiya tha.
hinglish.Everything so far ends in prose — a para: Ab tak sab kuchh prose par khatam hota tha — ek paragraph jise insaan padhta aur jaanchta hai. Woh bilkul theek product hai. Woh raste ka ant bhi hai, kyunki software paragraph padh nahi sakta.
hinglish.The moment you want the AI to feed somet: Jaise hi aap chahte hain ki AI kisi aur cheez ko khilaaye — claim route kare, record update kare, ticket khole, document ko review ke liye flag kare — aapko prose nahi chahiye. Aapko fields chahiye. Ek decision, ek amount, ek date, ek confidence. Naam wale, type wale, aur hamesha maujood.
hinglish.The obvious first attempt is to ask nice: Pehla seedha prayaas hota hai vinamrata se maangna: JSON mein jawaab do, keys decision, amount aur reason ke saath. Aur yeh zyadatar kaam karta hai, aur theek yahi dikkat hai.
hinglish.You ask politely, in a well-written inst: Aap achchi tarah likhi instruction ke saath, ek achche model par, vinamrata se maangte hain. Ek hazaar jawaabon mein se kitne percent sahi shape mein aayenge?
hinglish.Because the failures do not announce the: Kyunki failures khud ka elaan nahi karte. Woh maafi ke saath aate hain, ya code block ke andar, ya ek extra comma ke saath, ya — sabse bura — bilkul sahi shape mein lekin andar ek bani hui value ke saath. Ab agla paragraph aapke liye ganit kare, usse pehle khud kijiye: das hazaar requests roz, 97 percent par.
hinglish.Usually 95 to 99 percent. Which sounds l: Aam taur par 95 se 99 percent. Jo pass lagta hai, aur is chapter ki sabse mehngi galatfahmi yahi hai.
hinglish.At 97 percent, a feature handling ten th: 97 percent par, roz das hazaar requests sambhalne wala feature roz teen sau baar fail hota hai. Chupchaap, production mein, us field mein jise aage koi component abhi maanne wala hai.
hinglish.The industrial answer is not a better-wo: Industrial jawaab behtar shabdon wali request nahi hai. Jawaab yeh hai ki maangna band karke bandhna shuru kijiye. Aap provider ko ek schema dete hain — us shape ka formal vivaran jo aapko chahiye — aur machine ko likhte waqt hi rok diya jaata hai ki woh us shape se bahar kuchh na banaye. Hatotsahit nahi. Roka gaya.
hinglish.This is worth pausing on, because it is: Yahan rukna banta hai, kyunki is course mein pehli baar koi dikkat kam nahi ki gayi, hataayi gayi hai. Chapter 2 ne aapko yeh farq sikhaya tha. Yeh uska achcha pehlu hai.
hinglish.But be precise about what you have bough: Lekin aapne kya kharida hai, is baare mein saaf rahiye, kyunki log ise aksar zyada padh lete hain.
hinglish.A schema guarantees the shape, not the t: Schema shape ki guarantee deta hai, sach ki nahi. Aapko vaada hai ki amount field mein ek number hoga. Aapko yeh vaada nahi hai ki woh sahi number hoga, aur yeh to bilkul nahi ki document mein koi number tha bhi.
hinglish.Which leads to the three design moves th: Isse woh teen design kadam nikalte hain jo kiye hue aadmi ko padhe hue aadmi se alag karte hain. Try kijiye:
hinglish.<strong>Fixed choices instead of free te: Free text ki jagah tay choices. Jo field sirf approved, rejected ya needs_review ho sakti hai, woh “Approved (pending)” mein nahi bhatak sakti aur usse aage padhne wali cheez chupchaap toot nahi sakti.
hinglish.<strong>Make “nothing here” sayable.</st: "Yahan kuchh nahi hai" kehne layak banaiye. Agar required field hamesha bharni hi hai, to aapne machine ko hukm de diya hai ki document chup ho tab kuchh bana le. hinglish.<strong>Demand a quotation.</strong> A f: Quotation maangiye. hinglish.A good description says what it returns,: Achcha description batata hai ki woh kya lautata hai, kya nahi lautata, aur kab kuchh aur behtar hai — kyunki do functions ke beech ki dhundhlahat aapka likha hua bug hai. hinglish.<strong>Every step multiplies the bill.<: Har step bill ko guna karta hai. Chapter 1 ne bataya tha ki har request poori conversation dobara bhejti hai. Loop use compound kar deta hai.
hinglish.A single call sends about 1,200 pieces o: Ek single call lagbhag 1,200 text ke tukde bhejta hai. Chhah step wala agent har step par badhti hui conversation dobara bhejta hai. Poora run motamoti single call ki cost ka kitna guna hoga?
hinglish.Which is why an agent that “only” adds t: Isiliye jo agent "sirf" do step aur jodta hai woh bill dogona kar sakta hai. Step count ek product decision hai jiske saath ek number juda hai, implementation ki detail nahi.
hinglish.Far more than six. Each step re-sends ev: Chhah se kahin zyada. hinglish.<strong>Reading and doing are different: Padhna aur karna do alag duniyaein hain. hinglish.That asymmetry, rather than any amount o: Yahi asamaanta, na ki kitni bhi testing, tay karni chahiye ki loop mein insaan kahan baithe. Aur yeh faisla aap karte hain, koi engineer aapke liye nahi.

hinglish.True or not, and what you would ask: Sach ya nahi, aur aap kya poochhenge
hinglish.A vendor tells you their huge context wi: Ek vendor aapse kehta hai ki unka bada context window aapki retrieval layer ko bekaar kar deta hai — har request mein poora document set daal dijiye. Aage padhne se pehle: kya yeh sach hai, aur pata karne ke liye aap kya poochhenge?
hinglish.The question that settles it in a meetin: Meeting mein faisla karne wala sawaal: mujhe poore window ke beech mein rakhe gaye fact par aapki accuracy dikhaiye, aur usi fact ko chhote window mein retrieve karke aane wali accuracy ke saath tulna kijiye.
hinglish.No, for two independent reasons, and you: Nahi, do alag wajahon se, aur aapko dono par adna chahiye. Bill nahi badla: das laakh text ke tukde bhejna har ek query par das laakh tukdon ka paisa hai, hamesha. Aur capacity attention nahi hai — model request mein rakhi cheez ko sach mein istemaal kar paane ki kshamata request bharne se bahut pehle girne lagti hai, khaaskar beech ke hisse mein.
hinglish.<strong>Reason one: the meter did not mo: Wajah ek: meter nahi hila. Yeh ganit hai, aur log ise chhod dete hain kyunki yeh boring hai. Badi request ki jitni cost hai utni hi rehti hai, har query par, har user se, hamesha. Retrieval size limit ka jugaad nahi hai. Wahi bill ko seemit rakhta hai.
hinglish.<strong>Reason two, which surprises peop: Wajah do, jo logon ko chaunkati hai: aapne jo bheja hai use istemaal kar paane ki model ki kshamata ceiling se bahut pehle girti hai. Fact shuruaat ke paas rakhiye to woh bharose se milta hai. Wahi fact ek lambi request ke beech mein rakhiye to woh kahin zyada baar chhoot jaata hai. Kahin error nahi aata. Bas jawaab galat hota hai.
hinglish.Capacity is not attention. That a docume: Capacity attention nahi hai. Document aa gaya, iska yeh sabooot bilkul nahi ki model use istemaal karega. Yeh do alag daawe hain, aur vendor pehla batate hain jabki aapko doosra chahiye.
hinglish.This reframes the job. It is not about t: Isse kaam ka roop hi badal jaata hai. Baat aapki instructions ki wording ki nahi hai — woh prompt engineering hai, aur woh logon ki soch se kam maayne rakhta hai. Baat yeh hai ki request mein jaayega kya, aur chhootega kya. Ab is faisle ka ek naam hai, context engineering, aur yeh zyadatar product ka kaam hai.

hinglish.A strong answer treats the request as a: Achcha jawaab request ko ek budget maanta hai jiska koi maalik hai, na ki jo apne aap jama ho gaya. Retrieve kiye gaye documents aam taur par sabse badi line hain aur sabse zyada dabaane layak — kam nikaaliye, ya ek re-ranking pass jodiye taaki kam tukdon mein behtar content aaye. Isse woh jawaab tootenge jinka source kai jagah faila hai, isliye aap andaaza lagane ki jagah apni answer key par dobara naapte hain. Uske baad history aati hai, jiske katne se follow-up sawaal tootte hain; function descriptions kaatna to seedha kshamata hi hata deta hai. Kiye hue aadmi ki pehchaan yahi hai ki woh batata hai kaat se kya khatre mein hai, aur phir use naapta hai.
hinglish.Two more instruments belong here. <stron: Do aur auzaar yahin aate hain. Caching: providers aapki request ke shuruaati hisse ka processed roop yaad rakh sakte hain, to agar woh hissa har baar bilkul ek jaisa ho to woh kaafi sasta aur tez ho jaata hai. Isse nikalne wala architectural nirdesh saada hai — sthir cheezein pehle, badalne wali baad mein.
hinglish.<strong>Compaction</strong>: when a long: Compaction: jab lambi conversation apne budget se bahar ho jaaye, to beech ka hissa summarise kar dijiye aur dono sire rakh lijiye. Yeh chalta hai, aur yeh bharose se theek ek kism ki jaankaari nasht karta hai — beech ki woh khaas barikiyan jinhe rakhne ka kisi ne socha hi nahi.
hinglish.And the thing this chapter finally lets: Aur woh baat jo yeh chapter aakhirkar aapko theek se kehne deta hai: jab koi kahe ki unka assistant kisi user ko "yaad rakhta hai", to poochhiye ki woh memory physically kahan rehti hai. Woh ek store hai jo aapne banaya hai, har message par dobara bheja jaata hai, aur har baar uska paisa lagta hai.
hinglish.You are about to hide one sentence insid: Aap ek sentence ko ek lambe context ke andar chhupakar model se dhoondhne ko kehne wale hain, teen gehraaiyon par. Kuchh chalane se pehle, har gehraai par recovery rate ka andaaza lagaiye: shuruaat, beech, ant. Teen percentage likhiye.

hinglish.Commonly 5/5 at 5%, 5/5 at 95%, and some: Aam taur par 5% par 5/5, 95% par 5/5, aur 50% par kuchh kam — aksar 2/5 ya 3/5. Aapke exact numbers hi aapki khoj hain. Agar har jagah 5/5 aaye, to filler lamba karte jaiye jab tak aisa na ho; yeh asar lambaai par nirbhar hai, aur aapki toot jaane wali lambaai dhoondhna hi asli deliverable hai.
hinglish.Not that the model is bad — that “it fit: Yeh nahi ki model kharaab hai — balki yeh ki "aa jaata hai" aur "kaam karta hai" do alag daawe hain, aur inme se sirf ek spec sheet padhkar naapa ja sakta hai.

hinglish.Typically: comparable accuracy on easy q: Aam taur par: aasaan sawaalon par barabar accuracy, un sawaalon par stuffing ka faayda jinke liye kai door-door ke sections chahiye, aur tokens mein 10–50× ka farq plus latency mein bada antar. Woh sentence likhiye jise aapke apne numbers support karte hain. Woh dono taraf ke naaron se zyada barik hoga.

hinglish.Stable-first shows lower latency from th: Jahan provider caching support karta hai, wahan sthir-pehle wala doosre call se latency kam dikhata hai. hinglish.Paying it to think first: Use pehle sochne ka paisa dena
hinglish.Some models work through a problem befor: Kuchh models jawaab dene se pehle samasya par kaam karte hain. Us sochne ka paisa aap dete hain, har sawaal par, aur woh lagbhag aadhe mauke par hi wasool hota hai.
hinglish.Say what you are actually buying when yo: Yeh batana ki thinking on karne par aap asal mein kya kharid rahe hain.

hinglish.You pay for text in and text out: Aap andar aur bahar jaate text ka paisa dete hain
hinglish.Thinking is text, so thinking has a pric: Sochna bhi text hai, isliye sochne ki keemat hai.

Thinking usme ek line jodta hai.
hinglish.For most of this course, the machine ans: Is course mein ab tak machine turant jawaab deti thi. Ek nayi kism pehle kuchh aur karti hai: woh apna kaam likh kar nikaalti hai — ek raasta aazmaana, use jaanchna, peechhe hatna — aur uske baad hi jawaab deti hai. Woh kaam aapko dikhta nahi.
